completedProjects.title: Distribution of Corona Relief Livelihood Essentials
completedProjects.summary: Women's Empowerment Trust, with the support of Women First (USA), distributed livelihood essentials as a corona relief initiative to 150 deserving families.
details: The initiative supported deserving families in Kundrandar Kovil block of Pudhukottai district.
Mrs. Tamilselvi. G, Managing Trustee, welcomed the gathering and explained the role of the Women First team.
Ms. Akilandeswari. M, Financial Trustee and project staff member, rendered the vote of thanks.
The trust remains highly grateful to the Women First team for its generosity.
